steps.message: Open the contacts app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.

Execute: adb shell "PKG=''; for p in com.google.android.contacts com.android.contacts; do pm path $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && PKG=$p && break; done; if [ -z \"$PKG\" ]; then PKG=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.APP_CONTACTS 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); fi; if [ -z \"$PKG\" ]; then echo 'ERROR: contacts package not found'; exit 1; fi; echo \"Using package: $PKG\"; perms=$(dumpsys package $PKG | sed -n '/requested permissions:/,/install permissions:/p' | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\(android.permission.[A-Z0-9_]*\)$/\1/p'); for perm in $perms; do pm grant $PKG $perm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; monkey -p $PKG -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; pidof $PKG && echo 'LAUNCHED'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "PKG=''; for p in com.google.android.contacts com.android.contacts; do pm path $p >/dev/null 2>&1 && PKG=$p && break; done; if [ -z \"$PKG\" ]; then PKG=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.APP_CONTACTS 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); fi; if [ -z \"$PKG\" ]; then echo 'ERROR: contacts package not found'; exit 1; fi; echo \"Using package: $PKG\"; perms=$(dumpsys package $PKG | sed -n '/requested permissions:/,/install permissions:/p' | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\(android.permission.[A-Z0-9_]*\)$/\1/p'); for perm in $perms; do pm grant $PKG $perm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; monkey -p $PKG -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; pidof $PKG && echo 'LAUNCHED'""
